subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` gain a public `transform` outcome whose replacement becomes the canonical stored user turn across embedded and CLI runners?
rationale: This changes the exported plugin contract and the meaning of persisted conversation history; code review cannot decide whether canonical transcript rewriting is the intended permanent product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Adopt canonical transform
options.body: Approve the public outcome after the CLI path targets the recorder-owned structured turn and real embedded/CLI proof confirms persistence and later-turn behavior.

options.title: Keep model-bound transforms
options.body: Preserve the earlier model-only design and document that plugins needing durable redaction must use a different owner-approved transcript API.

options.title: Decline the new outcome
options.body: Keep `before_agent_run` limited to existing pass/block behavior and close the transform direction until a broader input-mutation API is designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical transform
recommendation.body: Approve the public outcome after the CLI path targets the recorder-owned structured turn and real embedded/CLI proof confirms persistence and later-turn behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current CLI transcript ownership and receipt model that constrains the safe implementation boundary.
